papers.title: Efficient predictive model of part distortion and residual stress in selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Dept. of Mechanical Engineering, The University of Alabama, Tuscaloosa, AL 35487, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Xiaoying Fang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute for Advanced Manufacturing, Shandong University of Technology, Zibo 255049, China

corresponding_authors.name: Y. B. Guo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Dept. of Mechanical Engineering, The University of Alabama, Tuscaloosa, AL 35487, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究选区激光熔化过程中的残余应力和变形预测，未涉及生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on general residual stress and distortion modeling in selective laser melting, with no connection to biomedical implants, stress shielding, fatigue, or surface roughness.

summary_zh.motivation: 建立高效模型预测SLM零件变形和残余应力
summary_zh.method: 采用热力耦合有限元方法模拟逐层熔化过程
summary_zh.result: 模型可准确预测变形趋势，但计算效率有待提升
summary_zh.validation: 与文献实验数据对比验证预测精度

summary_en.motivation: To develop an efficient predictive model for part distortion and residual stress in selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A thermo-mechanical finite element model is used to simulate the layer-by-layer melting process.
summary_en.result: The model accurately predicts distortion trends, though computational efficiency remains a challenge.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing predictions with experimental data from the literature.

papers.title: Integral method of preparation and fabrication of metal matrix composite: Selective laser melting of in-situ nano/submicro-sized carbides reinforced iron matrix composites
papers.first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Materials Processing and Die & Mould Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, China

corresponding_authors.name: Bo Song
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Materials Processing and Die & Mould Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究金属基复合材料的制备与力学性能，不涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on metal matrix composite fabrication via selective laser melting, with no mention of biomedical applications, porous structures for osseointegration, stress shielding, or fatigue testing relevant to hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过原位合成纳米/亚微米碳化物增强铁基复合材料，改善力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化技术制备原位碳化物增强铁基复合材料。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备出纳米/亚微米碳化物均匀分布的复合材料，硬度与强度显著提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观结构表征和力学测试验证增强效果。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the mechanical properties of iron matrix composites by in-situ synthesizing nano/submicron carbides.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate iron matrix composites with in-situ formed carbide reinforcements.
summary_en.result: Uniform distribution of nano/submicron carbides was achieved, leading to significantly improved hardness and strength.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization and mechanical testing confirmed the reinforcement effect.

papers.title: Biomechanical model based evaluation of Total Hip Arthroplasty therapy outcome
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department for Orthopaedic Surgery, University Hospital RWTH Aachen, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Jörg Eschweiler
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department for Orthopaedic Surgery, University Hospital RWTH Aachen, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文使用生物力学模型评估全髋关节置换术结果，可能涉及应力遮挡或微动，但缺乏对格鲁恩分区的详细定量分析。
llm.why_not_core: Does not explicitly quantify stress shielding or micromotion in Gruen zones, and lacks patient-specific modeling with contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估全髋关节置换术后临床效果的生物力学因素
summary_zh.method: 建立三维有限元模型模拟植入后力学环境
summary_zh.result: 模型可预测假体周围骨重建趋势
summary_zh.validation: 通过与文献数据对比验证模型有效性

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate biomechanical factors influencing clinical outcomes after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A three-dimensional finite element model was developed to simulate the mechanical environment after implantation.
summary_en.result: The model predicts periprosthetic bone remodeling trends.
summary_en.validation: Model validity was confirmed by comparing results with literature data.

papers.title: Effect of solution treatment on the fracture mechanisms of AlSi10Mg parts produced by Selective Laser Melting

corresponding_authors.name: Jocelyn Delahaye
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Université de Liège - ULiège > Département d'Aérospatiale et Mécanique > Science des Matériaux métalliques >  >

papers.venue: Open Repository and Bibliography (University of Liège)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究AlSi10Mg合金的热处理对断裂机制的影响，与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on AlSi10Mg alloy fracture mechanisms after solution treatment, with no biomedical implant context, no porous structure design, no LPBF for biomedical alloys, and no fatigue or osseointegration testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究固溶处理对SLM AlSi10Mg合金断裂机制的影响
summary_zh.method: 对SLM成型的AlSi10Mg试样进行不同固溶处理，分析微观组织和断口
summary_zh.result: 固溶处理改变了共晶Si颗粒形态，影响断裂方式
summary_zh.validation: 微观组织观察和力学性能测试

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of solution treatment on the fracture behavior of AlSi10Mg parts fabricated by Selective Laser Melting.
summary_en.method: As-built AlSi10Mg samples were subjected to various solution treatment conditions and subsequently characterized by microstructural analysis and fractography.
summary_en.result: Solution treatment altered the morphology of eutectic Si particles, leading to a transition in fracture mechanism from ductile to brittle.
summary_en.validation: Validation through microstructural observation and mechanical testing.
